package wasm

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type viewEvent struct {
	Kind   uint32 `json:"kind"`
	Before uint32 `json:"before"`
	Pages  uint32 `json:"pages"`
}

type viewStep struct {
	Export string      `json:"export"`
	Trap   string      `json:"trap"`
	Args   []uint32    `json:"args"`
	Memory []byte      `json:"memory"`
	Events []viewEvent `json:"events"`
	Stack  uint32      `json:"stack"`
}

type viewHistory struct {
	Name  string     `json:"name"`
	Steps []viewStep `json:"steps"`
}

type viewHost struct {
	module *Module
	events []viewEvent
}

func (host *viewHost) Init(value any) { host.module = value.(*Module) }

func (host *viewHost) Xtouch(kind int32) {
	memory := *host.module.Xmemory().Slice()
	host.events = append(host.events, viewEvent{uint32(kind), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory), uint32(len(memory) >> 16)})
	switch kind {
	case 0:
		return
	case 1:
	case 2:
		if host.module.Xmemory().Grow(1, 4) < 0 {
			panic("fixture import growth failed")
		}
	case 3:
		replacement := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xde}, len(memory))
		*host.module.Xmemory().Slice() = replacement
	default:
		panic("unsupported fixture import")
	}
	memory = *host.module.Xmemory().Slice()
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(memory[32:], 0x0a0b0c0d+uint32(len(host.events)))
}

func invokeView(module *Module, step viewStep) (trap string) {
	defer func() {
		if value := recover(); value != nil {
			if fault, ok := value.(runtime.Error); ok && strings.Contains(fault.Error(), "out of range") {
				trap = "memory"
			} else {
				trap = fmt.Sprintf("%T: %v", value, value)
			}
		}
	}()
	arg := func(index int) int32 { return int32(step.Args[index]) }
	switch step.Export {
	case "publish":
		module.Xpublish(arg(0), arg(1), arg(2))
	case "reverse":
		module.Xreverse(arg(0), arg(1), arg(2))
	case "copy_tuple":
		module.Xcopy_tuple(arg(0), arg(1), arg(2))
	case "mixed_tuple":
		module.Xmixed_tuple(arg(0), arg(1))
	case "wrapping_tuple":
		module.Xwrapping_tuple(arg(0))
	case "after_import":
		module.Xafter_import(arg(0), arg(1))
	case "grow_tuple":
		module.Xgrow_tuple(arg(0), arg(1))
	case "loop_tuples":
		module.Xloop_tuples(arg(0), arg(1), arg(2))
	case "conditional_tuple":
		module.Xconditional_tuple(arg(0), arg(1))
	default:
		panic("unsupported fixture export")
	}
	return trap
}

func TestMemoryViewHistories(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("histories.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var histories []viewHistory
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &histories); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(histories) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("missing independent memory histories")
	}
	for _, history := range histories {
		t.Run(history.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			host := new(viewHost)
			module := New(host)
			for index, step := range history.Steps {
				trap := invokeView(module, step)
				memory := *module.Xmemory().Slice()
				if trap != step.Trap || !bytes.Equal(memory, step.Memory) || uint32(module.Xstack_value()) != step.Stack {
					t.Fatalf("memory-view history mismatch at step %d (%s): trap=%q want=%q memory-equal=%v len=%d/%d stack=%d/%d", index, step.Export, trap, step.Trap, bytes.Equal(memory, step.Memory), len(memory), len(step.Memory), uint32(module.Xstack_value()), step.Stack)
				}
				if len(host.events) != len(step.Events) {
					t.Fatalf("memory-view import history mismatch at step %d: %v/%v", index, host.events, step.Events)
				}
				for event, want := range step.Events {
					if host.events[event] != want {
						t.Fatalf("memory-view import order mismatch at step %d: %v/%v", index, host.events, step.Events)
					}
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMemoryViewLogicalLength(t *testing.T) {
	module := New(new(viewHost))
	backing := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xef}, 64)
	clear(backing[:12])
	*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing[:12]
	step := viewStep{Export: "publish", Args: []uint32{8, 0x11223344, 0x55667788}}
	if trap := invokeView(module, step); trap != "memory" {
		t.Fatalf("memory-view logical-length trap mismatch: %q", trap)
	}
	if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(backing[8:]) != 0x11223344 || !bytes.Equal(backing[12:], bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xef}, 52)) || module.Xstack_value() != 49136 {
		t.Fatal("memory-view logical-length prefix mismatch")
	}
}

func TestMemoryViewHeaderReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	for _, loop := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("loop=%v", loop), func(t *testing.T) {
			host := new(viewHost)
			module := New(host)
			old := *module.Xmemory().Slice()
			if loop {
				module.Xloop_tuples(3, 0, 3)
			} else {
				module.Xafter_import(3, 80)
			}
			memory := *module.Xmemory().Slice()
			if &old[0] == &memory[0] {
				t.Fatal("fixture did not replace the header")
			}
			if loop {
				if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory) != 0x11223344 || len(host.events) != 3 {
					t.Fatal("memory-view loop capture mismatch")
				}
				for index, event := range host.events {
					want := uint32(0x11223344)
					if index == 0 {
						want = 0
					}
					if event.Before != want {
						t.Fatal("memory-view loop observation mismatch", host.events)
					}
				}
			} else if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory[80:]) != 0x0a0b0c0e || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory[84:]) != 0x55667788 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(old[80:]) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("memory-view replacement capture mismatch")
			}
			if module.Xstack_value() != 49152 {
				t.Fatal("memory-view replacement restoration mismatch")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMemoryViewGrowthStorage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, spare := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("spare=%v", spare), func(t *testing.T) {
			module := New(new(viewHost))
			capacity := 65536
			if spare {
				capacity *= 3
			}
			backing := make([]byte, 65536, capacity)
			copy(backing, *module.Xmemory().Slice())
			*module.Xmemory().Slice() = backing
			module.Xgrow_tuple(65536, 1)
			memory := *module.Xmemory().Slice()
			if (&memory[0] == &backing[0]) != spare {
				t.Fatal("fixture growth did not exercise requested storage path")
			}
			if len(memory) != 131072 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory[65536:]) != 0x11223344 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(memory[65540:]) != 0x55667788 || module.Xstack_value() != 49152 {
				t.Fatal("memory-view growth capture mismatch")
			}
		})
	}
}
